annotations.title: AI tariff classification (HS / HTS code) verified against the US schedule

description: AI tariff classification (HS / HTS code) verified against the US schedule — Describe a product in plain English and get its likely 6-digit HS subheading(s), each checked against the live USITC Harmonized Tariff Schedule: verified true/false, the U.S. tariff lines under it with general / special / column 2 duty rates, statistical suffixes, a best match, the deciding product facts and the questions an importer should confirm. Params: product (required, up to 1500 chars: material, function, use), origin (optional ISO2 country of origin - adds a Chapter 99 extra-duty reminder). AI-assisted, not a binding ruling. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

product.description: e.g. 14-inch laptop computer with keyboard and screen, 1.4 kg

name: ai_hts_classify
